strategic_architecture: Solo-commander Simic (U/G) fast-combo archetype. Kinnan doubles mana produced by nonland permanents (mana dorks/rocks), functioning as both an enabler and a static combo piece (e.g. + Basalt Monolith, or + a mana dork + Freed from the Real/Pemmin's Aura, both go infinite with Kinnan out). Game plan: ramp into a fast Kinnan, use the doubling to assemble infinite mana, convert to a win via a draw outlet into Finale of Devastation or similar. Materially different game plan from any Tymna/Thrasios pairing - no card-advantage-engine commander, wins via mana-doubling combo density instead. Sources: tappedout.net 'cEDH primer Kinnan, Combo Prodigy', EDHREC 'Building Kinnan, Bonder Prodigy for cEDH', Learn cEDH.
